test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
estimated_root_cause: Coupon success UI is shown, but total stays at ¥418 instead of applying the expected 10% discount to ¥380.
recommended_action: Fix discount calculation or total recomputation when coupon is applied; verify subtotal/rounding logic.

test_case: カートページ › 数量の+ボタンで数量が増える
estimated_root_cause: Test uses a brittle text selector for the '+' qty button and waits on .first(); the element is likely ambiguous or not matched as written.
recommended_action: Use a stable selector/test id for the increment button and assert visibility/enabled state before clicking.

test_case: チェックアウトページ › チェックアウトページが表示される
estimated_root_cause: After addItemAndGoToCheckout, navigation does not reach checkout and remains on the cart page ('Your Cart').
recommended_action: Fix checkout transition/navigation flow after adding an item; verify click handler/router redirect.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › ステータスが「preparing」に進む
estimated_root_cause: Order status progression is time-dependent and may not advance from received to preparing within the test’s wait window.
recommended_action: Poll with a longer timeout or control/mock status progression instead of relying on random delay.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › 最終的にステータスが「completed」になる
estimated_root_cause: Async status update never reached completed within 15s; order remained at received due to nondeterministic progression timing.
recommended_action: Make status transitions deterministic in tests or increase/poll timeout with intermediate-state handling.

test_case: レート制限テスト › 通常のページ遷移でエラーが出ない
estimated_root_cause: Assertion uses locator('h1, .product-card'), which matches multiple elements and triggers Playwright strict mode.
recommended_action: Assert a single stable element or use .first()/.nth() with a precise selector for page readiness.
